termination: Actual and imagined fall at root height <0.35m or upright Z<0.5. Reference end is finite-task terminal with zero tail; score terminal-step reward once. Model fall mask is hard and not differentiated.
common_prior: One identical pre-supervision zero-output checkpoint for all methods and training seeds. It includes previously fitted balance slopes, static kinematics and normalization from reference-source observations; no claim of training from scratch or a prior-free mocap method. Independently seeded collection/optimization defines the three new training runs.
data_access: Fresh own-policy physics only. Reference motion/reset snapshots are commands/setup; source controls are not labels. Each seed's first 27 noisy episodes are shared by the two methods and charged to each standalone learner. Three origin-zero diagnostic episodes per seed never train models, values or actors. All later episodes use each arm's own policy. No previous model/value/direction checkpoint is inherited.
critic: Same zero-initialized physical-return critic and 128 fitting updates per cycle in both arms, including full causal controller memory. With-tail uses its input derivative after H32; prefix-only never calls the critic inside actor imagination. The unused prefix-arm critic is still fitted/stored and its cost reported for the controlled budget. This is not the paper's imagined-GAE recipe.
actor_objective: Each cycle samples all 27 episode starts spanning nine clips and 0/10/20s resets. With-tail maximizes H32 discounted reward plus physical-return value; prefix-only maximizes the same H32 reward without a tail. Both perform 12 Adam steps per cycle. Each proposed parameter update is rescaled to keep raw action-logit RMS change <=0.005 on 256 fixed current-cycle history samples; shrink further if needed. Adam moments remain from the original gradients. The cap is not a guarantee on future closed-loop actions or returns.
budget_and_selection: Three cycles, 27 episodes per cycle, 900 world-model/128 critic fitting updates and 12 actor steps per cycle in each arm/seed. Each cycle contains all three reset origins to avoid the old sequential-origin curriculum. All six final-cycle actors receive the unchanged 27-cell quality suite. No checkpoint/seed selection, intermediate quality checks or threshold changes.
costs: Keep common reference/teacher/feedback/supervised-baseline development separate; report fresh collection, model diagnostic collection, model/critic/actor optimization, final evaluation and serialization. Sequential local CPU measurements, not GPU-hour equivalence. A quality-failing method has no successful cost-to-target.
scope: Actual paired full-reference with-tail/prefix-only training from a shared inherited actor prior. Known training-family resets; not successful learning efficiency, unseen-motion coverage, full phase acceptance, hardware qualification or restart infrastructure.
protocol_revision_reason: New controlled tail-training experiment after physical prefix-direction probes. Compared with earlier studies, both arms share interleaved reset coverage, larger world-model fitting budget and an explicit small logit-step cap. Only critic-tail use differs within this pair; no isolated comparison to historical unconstrained/PPO training is claimed.
